game.title: Las Vegas Raiders at Los Angeles Chargers

lede: Los Angeles Chargers carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#27 in EPA per play) and the better defensive rating with it, so the ratings point the same way on both sides of the ball.
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Los Angeles Chargers -6.2 with a fair total of 38.9 — inside a touchdown, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Las Vegas Raiders pass offence vs Los Angeles Chargers pass defence, which sits −0.257 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.
